description: Job Title: Administrative Analyst Job Description The Administrative Analyst promotes and maintains a safe and efficient work environment while overseeing key administrative processes that support large, complex projects. This role focuses on processing and tracking staff timesheets and procurement card reports, compiling and analyzing project data, and developing weekly and monthly reports. The Administrative Analyst organizes and catalogs critical project documentation, gathers information, and prepares comprehensive monthly project status PowerPoint presentations. The position also serves as the administrative owner for shared drives and SharePoint sites, supports records retention activities for major construction projects, and ensures adherence to established administrative, accounting, and compliance procedures. In addition, the role includes a wide range of office management duties, support for executive administrators when needed, and ongoing communication with Compliance and HR in support of the project team. Ensure adherence to applicable administrative, accounting, and compliance procedures in all work processes and documentation. Job Title: Connectivity Project Analyst Job Description: The Connectivity Project Analyst supports strategic utility connectivity initiatives with a focus on long-haul fiber infrastructure and grid modernization programs. This role delivers project controls, cost management, scheduling, reporting, GIS support, and dashboard development to drive the successful execution of large-scale fiber and communications infrastructure projects. The analyst works closely with project managers, engineering teams, finance stakeholders, and utility leadership to provide clear visibility into project performance, budgets, schedules, and key program metrics. Responsibilities: Develop, maintain, and update detailed project schedules using Primavera P6 or equivalent scheduling tools. Collaborate with project managers to build schedules, track milestones, perform critical path analysis, and produce progress reports. Monitor project performance to identify schedule risks, delays, and recovery opportunities across multiple initiatives. Support portfolio-level reporting for multiple fiber and connectivity programs to ensure consistent oversight and coordination. Track project expenditures, forecasts, and overall budget performance to support effective cost management. Assist with project estimating, cost analysis, and financial reporting activities for utility and infrastructure projects. Develop and maintain cost tracking tools and reporting dashboards to improve financial visibility. Support monthly cost reviews, variance analysis, and project forecasting to manage cost and schedule performance. Collaborate with project teams to monitor budget adherence and overall financial performance of capital programs. Develop, maintain, and enhance Power BI dashboards and performance reporting tools for stakeholders at all levels. Create executive-level reports and visualizations that support data-driven decision-making. Collect, validate, and analyze project data from multiple systems and databases to ensure data quality and consistency. Provide reporting on project health, resource utilization, schedule performance, and financial metrics. Develop, maintain, and administer SharePoint project sites to support collaboration and information sharing. Improve project workflows, document management, and information accessibility through SharePoint and related tools. Support data governance, version control, and project documentation standards to maintain accurate project records. Maintain centralized repositories for schedules, reports, cost information, and project deliverables. Support GIS and mapping activities by maintaining accurate spatial data related to fiber and connectivity projects. Assist with mapping and visualization efforts associated with fiber infrastructure and grid modernization programs. Coordinate with engineering and field teams to ensure accurate project data and spatial information in GIS systems. Assist with route planning, project tracking, and asset documen

Job Title: Structural Dynamics Analyst Job Description We are seeking a Structural Dynamics Analyst to support the design, analysis, verification, and qualification of advanced aerospace systems. This role involves performing structural dynamics assessments, developing finite element models, and evaluating hardware performance throughout the product development lifecycle. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams to ensure structural integrity, dynamic performance, and compliance with program requirements. Responsibilities Perform structural dynamics assessments for aerospace systems. Develop finite element models to evaluate hardware performance. Conduct loads, vibration, shock, acoustic, and modal analyses. Support hardware test campaigns and correlate analytical models to test data. Ensure compliance with aerospace industry standards and requirements. Present technical findings to multidisciplinary teams. Essential Skills Bachelors degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related engineering discipline from an accredited institution. Minimum of 5 years of experience performing structural dynamics analyses for aerospace, spaceflight, or other complex engineered systems. Proficiency with engineering analysis tools such as MATLAB, Python, or similar software packages. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Additional Skills & Qualifications Experience supporting spacecraft, launch vehicle, satellite, or human spaceflight programs. Proficiency with Beta CAE software products, including ANSA, META, and EPILYSIS. Experience working within Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) environments such as Windchill. Master of Science degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related technical field. Demonstrated project leadership, task management, or technical lead experience. Work Environment The candidate will be working in an environment split between 80% office work and 20% shop interaction with technicians. Job Type & Location This is a Permanent position based out of Houston, TX. Pay and Benefits The pay range for this position is $43.00 - $45.00/hr. Job Title: Substation Project Closeout Analyst Job Description The Substation Project Closeout Analyst is responsible for managing the closeout of transmission and distribution substation capital projects after construction is substantially complete or the assets have been placed in service.
